checks.name: Primary-key uniqueness
checks.description: Every table has unique primary keys (business identifiers).

checks.name: Foreign-key integrity
checks.description: Every foreign key references an existing parent record.

checks.name: Business identifier format
checks.description: IDs follow the documented conventions (EMP-000001, LVE-2026-000001, ...).

checks.name: Unique business attributes
checks.description: Employee e-mail, cost-center code and payment reference are unique.

checks.name: Required fields
checks.description: Core descriptive fields are present and not blank.

checks.name: Valid enum values
checks.description: Status / type columns only contain values of the application enums.

checks.name: Valid date ranges
checks.description: Start <= end for employment, policies, assignments, budgets and canonical requests.

checks.name: Claim total equals the sum of its lines
checks.description: total_amount = sum of positive line amounts.

checks.name: Leave balances reconcile with the ledger
checks.description: Each balance component equals the sum of its ledger deltas; available = opening + accrued + carried - used - pending.

checks.name: Approved leave consumes balance exactly once
checks.description: Every APPROVED request has exactly one CONSUME and a net used amount equal to its business days.

checks.name: Rejected / cancelled / unapproved leave does not consume balance
checks.description: Non-approved requests have no net used days; only pending requests hold a reservation.

checks.name: Approval routes follow configured thresholds
checks.description: The levels and roles of every approval route equal those prescribed by the active approval rules.

checks.name: Approval actors possess authority
checks.description: Actors were active, are not the requester, and hold the role's authority and reporting-line relationship.

checks.name: Reimbursement only for eligible, finally approved claims
checks.description: Every reimbursement belongs to an APPROVED + ELIGIBLE claim with all steps complete and matching amount; every APPROVED claim has one.

checks.name: Duplicate reimbursement prevented
checks.description: At most one reimbursement per claim; rejected duplicate attempts are recorded.

checks.name: Budget consumption reconciles with approved expenses
checks.description: Approved spend per budget equals the sum of reimbursements and never exceeds the allocation.

checks.name: Lifecycle transitions are valid
checks.description: Audit trails replay as valid, continuous state-machine paths ending in the current state.

checks.name: Valid organisational hierarchy
checks.description: One root, no cycles, no self-management, managers rank above reports.

checks.name: No unexplained negative amounts
checks.description: Negative / zero amounts exist only on explicitly INVALID lines.

checks.name: Valid employment dates
checks.description: Termination date only for TERMINATED employees and never before joining.

checks.name: Consistent currencies
checks.description: Line, claim, reimbursement, policy and budget currencies agree (explained INVALID_CURRENCY claims excepted).

checks.name: No unexpected duplicate receipts
checks.description: A receipt hash reused by live claims is always explained by a detected DUPLICATE_RECEIPT anomaly.

checks.name: No overlapping approved leave
checks.description: Detects corrupted canonical data: two APPROVED requests of one employee that overlap.

checks.name: Canonical records never carry invalid references
checks.description: Claims without a cost center only exist in non-live states and keep the submitted value.

checks.name: Deliberately invalid submissions preserved (informational)
checks.description: Submissions with invalid references or inverted dates are kept in staging / as rejected records - this is expected, not corruption.
